In India's 2024 general election, AI-generated persona bots and synthetic content were deployed at an unprecedented scale to shape narratives.
Qatar's November 2024 constitutional referendum approved the elimination of legislative elections for the Shura Council with 90.6 percent of the vote.
At least 117 algorithmic systems are currently deployed across public agencies in Chile, including those for healthcare priority and school placement.
Chile's 1993 Cybercrime Law was not updated to include offenses like phishing and data interception until 2022.
Hungary's government-run Voks 2025 consultation on Ukraine's EU accession was organized and executed in a matter of weeks.
Generative AI can ingest a country's entire legal code and constitutional jurisprudence to produce a coherent draft law in seconds.
AI-driven microtargeting and automation enable optimized signature gathering by directing volunteers to specific neighborhoods at optimal times.
